description: This file defines a controller class for managing logs within the OpenCart admin interface. It includes methods for viewing, downloading, and clearing log files, with logic for handling file operations and user permissions.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Controller class for handling log viewing, downloading, and clearing in the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the logs overview page, including breadcrumbs, errors, and log files.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Handles the downloading of specific log files with validation, headers setup, and file content output.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the specified log file after permission check, resets JSON response accordingly.
